name: qfd_tt_head_static_h16u-h16u-COMMIT
purpose: h16t successor: single clock region (SRAMs on ck_head, raw ck_pm0/ck_pm1 entries deleted); removes all cross-root reg<->SRAM paths without rings or added edges; same bound_r4 cells, floorplan and pins.

bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qfd_tt_ctlm_static_hr_safe32_native32_1r u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv results/rtl/qw_head_safe32_1020/h16u/native32_1r_param.v results/rtl/qw_head_safe32_1020/bound_r4/native32_helpers.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2_bb.v physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_32x128_m1/ot_sram_1r1w_32x128_m1_bb.v && echo lint-ok

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_tt_head_static_h16u/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_tt_head_static_h16u/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_tt_head_static_h16u --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_qfd_tt_ctlm_static_hr_safe32_native32_1r --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_32x128_m1 --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_64x512_m1_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: h16t gate FAIL 4 (cross_clock only; within-root spread 61.1/58.5 PASS, GRT0, census32): the 8 head SRAMs sat on raw clock entries ck_pm0 (5) / ck_pm1 (3) while all 7,908 flops are on ck_head -> direct reg<->SRAM paths between three roots (TT -111/-21.8/-378.1/-137.1 ps incl. 150-210 ps distinct-entry reserve), forbidden by the owner clock rule 10-20 08:55. The parent (qfd_tt_ctlm_dv u_hr) drives all three entries from the same ck, so the SRAM regions had no physical purpose: h16u deletes the raw entries (results/rtl/qw_head_safe32_1020/h16u/make_1r.py, 4 header/assign edits, cell netlist unchanged) and the head is ONE clock region: one CTS root ck_head reaching 7,908 flops + 8 SRAM clock pins, spread <=80 TT/FF inside it, no region crossing, so no landing ring and 0 added edges.
